mainEntity.name: How much does a Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A replacement engine for a Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi typically costs £1,450-£2,250 for a reconditioned supply-only unit. Used engines start from £650. Fitting adds 8-12 hours of labour at £65-£90/hr, bringing the total fitted cost to £2,000-£3,500 at an independent specialist. Dealer pricing is significantly higher.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of EGR or DPF failure in a Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common signs are loss of power, rough idle, poor fuel economy, and the engine management light illuminating. On diesel Kadjars, EGR valve clogging causes hesitation and smoke, while DPF blockage triggers warning lights and limp mode.

mainEntity.name: Is the Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi a reliable engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 1.5 dCi is generally regarded as a dependable engine, but it has several well-documented weak points. EGR valve clogging, DPF issues and injector wear are common on higher-mileage examples. Regular maintenance - particularly timing belt replacement every 60,000 miles or 5 years - is the key to longevity.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the vehicle's value. Early Kadjar examples (2015-2017) are worth £4,000-£10,000 - a full engine replacement at £2,000-£3,500 may represent 20-70% of the car's value. Later examples with higher values (£8,000-£18,000) generally justify replacement if the rest of the car is in good condition.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the K9K 730 and K9K 732 engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: The K9K 730 and K9K 732 both produce 110hp and share the same 1.5-litre (1,461cc) displacement. The K9K 730 was fitted to early Kadjar models (2015-2017) while the K9K 732 was fitted from 2015-2018. Both engines share the same architecture and failure points.

mainEntity.name: Does the Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi have a timing belt or chain?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 1.5 dCi (K9K) uses a timing belt, not a chain. The belt requires replacement at the manufacturer-recommended interval - typically every 60,000 miles or 5 years, whichever comes first. Neglecting the timing belt can lead to catastrophic engine failure if it breaks.

historyTimeline.h2: Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi, powered by the legendary K9K engine family, has been the most popular powertrain choice for UK Kadjar buyers since the model's launch in 2015. Sharing the CMF-CD platform with the Nissan Qashqai, the Kadjar's 1.5 dCi diesel engine - available in outputs from 110hp to 115hp - became the default choice for fleet, private hire and family users seeking a balance of economy and torque. The K9K engine has a cast-iron block, an aluminium cylinder head and a timing belt drive, and its widespread use across multiple manufacturers (including Nissan, Mercedes and Dacia) has made it a familiar unit to UK specialists.

milestones.description: Kadjar launched with 1.5 dCi 110 (K9K 730/732) offering 110hp and 260Nm of torque; Euro 6 emissions compliance
2018 - K9K 736, K9K 738 and K9K 740 variants introduced; continued 110hp output with revised emissions hardware
1.5 Blue dCi 115 (K9K 872) introduced with AdBlue/SCR system for Euro 6d-TEMP compliance
2022 - Facelift Kadjar continues with 1.5 Blue dCi 115 as the sole diesel option; K9K 872 remains in production
Kadjar production ends; replaced by the all-new Renault Austral

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi (K9K family) is one of Europe's most popular diesel engines, but it has several well-documented failure points. The 1.5 dCi accounts for approximately 78% of UK Kadjar engine search volume. Some K9K units exceed 300,000 km without issue, while others suffer serious failures. Rebuilt engines supplied through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: EGR Valve & DPF Clogging - Emissions System Failures in the Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi
problems.affectedModels: Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi (K9K, all variants, particularly Euro 5/6 models)
problems.rootCause: EGR valve clogging is one of the most common diesel problems on the Kadjar 1.5 dCi, causing rough idle, poor fuel economy and engine hesitation. DPF clogging is also common, especially on vehicles used primarily for short urban journeys. EGR repair costs can reach €1,500-2,500 on some models. Injectors can seize in the cylinder head, requiring complete replacement of the assembly.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Professional EGR valve cleaning or removal
repairOptions.longevity: Cost-effective first-line response for rough idle and hesitation
Effective if DPF is not heavily blocked

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New EGR valve, DPF unit, and associated gaskets
repairOptions.longevity: Required if cleaning does not resolve the issue

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of rebuilt unit with upgraded components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Only if emissions system failure has caused turbo or engine damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Apply this UK-wide decision framework to your Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi. Early examples (2015-2017) typically range £4,000-£10,000; later examples (2018-2022) range £8,000-£18,000. - Vehicle worth under ~£5,000: used engine typically makes more sense than a full rebuilt unit - or consider scrapping if repair costs exceed value - Vehicle worth ~£5,000-£10,000: evaluate both; EGR/DPF repair is viable if the car is otherwise sound - Vehicle worth £10,000+: reconditioned/rebuilt usually justifies the premium via warranty and reliability
problems.recommendation: If your Kadjar 1.5 dCi is used primarily for short journeys, ensure it gets regular motorway runs to keep the DPF healthy. If the EGR valve is clogged, professional cleaning is a cost-effective solution - but if the DPF warning appears, act quickly; a forced regeneration is far cheaper than a full replacement.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi engine prices

problems.h4: Timing Belt Failure - The K9K's Critical Service Item
problems.rootCause: The K9K uses a timing belt, not a chain. Renault recommends replacement every 60,000 miles or 5 years. Some sources indicate 60,000 km (approx 37,000 miles) as the interval. If the belt breaks, the engine suffers catastrophic valve-to-piston contact, requiring a full rebuild or replacement.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New timing belt, tensioner, water pump
repairOptions.longevity: Essential preventative maintenance every 60,000 miles or 5 years

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of rebuilt unit with upgraded components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if belt has broken and caused valve/piston damage

problems.recommendation: Timing belt replacement is the single most important maintenance item on the Kadjar 1.5 dCi. If your car is approaching 60,000 miles or is over 5 years old, have the belt replaced immediately. A £300-£500 preventative job is far cheaper than a £2,000-£3,500 engine replacement.
problems.cta: -> Compare Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi engine replacement costs

problems.h4: Injector & Fuel System Failure - Common Rail Issues in the Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi
problems.affectedModels: Renault Kadjar 1.5 dCi (K9K, particularly pre-2018 models)
problems.rootCause: Injectors are prone to wear over time, causing hard starting (especially when cold), unstable idle, loss of power and "check injection" warnings. On early K9K engines, the high-pressure fuel pump can wear prematurely, producing metal swarf that contaminates the entire fuel system.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New injectors, fuel system flush, new fuel filter
repairOptions.longevity: Cost-effective if caught before pump swarf has contaminated the entire system

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of rebuilt unit with upgraded components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended if pump failure has caused widespread fuel system contamination or engine damage

problems.recommendation: If your Kadjar 1.5 dCi has rough running, hard starting or loss of power, have the injectors and fuel pump inspected immediately. Early injector replacement costs £500-£900 at a specialist. Ignoring the issue risks widespread fuel system contamination and a £2,000-£3,500 engine replacement bill.
